HYRULE OF WARCRAFT
==================
Ocarina of Time's movement and combat, with World of Warcraft's RPG systems on top.
Runs fully offline and single-player.

FIRST LAUNCH (one time only)
  1. Double-click soh.exe
  2. When it asks for a ROM, choose your Ocarina of Time .z64 file
     (your NTSC 1.2 US ROM works).
  3. Wait about a minute while it builds oot.o2r from your ROM. After that it starts instantly.

DEFAULT KEYBOARD CONTROLS (change them under Esc > Settings > Controls, or plug in a controller)
  Move .......... W A S D        Attack / B .... C
  Action / A .... X              Z-Target ...... Z
  Shield / R .... R              Map / L ....... E
  C-buttons ..... Arrow keys     Start/Pause ... Space
  Menu .......... Esc            Fullscreen .... F11

WARCRAFT HOTKEYS
  I = Character sheet (gear + stats)     B = Bags (equip, sell)
  L = Quest Log                          N = Talents
  K = Professions                        Q = Drink best healing potion
  (There are also clickable buttons above the XP bar.)

HOW IT WORKS
  * Levels 1-60. Kill enemies, discover zones and finish quests for XP.
  * Every enemy has a level and a nameplate. The color shows the difficulty:
    grey = trivial, green = easy, yellow = even, orange = hard, red = very hard, ?? = deadly.
  * Strength = damage, Agility = critical hits, Stamina and Armor = less damage taken,
    Spirit = faster health regen out of combat.
  * Loot has WoW rarities: grey (junk - sell it), white, green, blue, purple, orange (legendary).
  * Quests: when you enter an area with work to do, a yellow "!" floats over a nearby
    person. Press L to accept. Go back to that area to turn in the quest ("?").
  * Talents: 1 point per level from 10 onward, in three trees (Courage / Wisdom / Power).
  * Professions: pick 2. Herbalism (cut grass and bushes), Mining (break rocks),
    Skinning (defeat beasts), Alchemy (potions and elixirs), Blacksmithing and
    Leatherworking (craft gear).
  * Dungeons (the Deku Tree, all temples, etc.) are tougher and drop better loot.
    The Raid is Ganon's Castle and Tower. Pick Normal, Heroic or Mythic difficulty in the
    Character sheet or under Esc > Enhancements > Warcraft.
  * Everything can be completed solo.

All Warcraft options (XP rate, regen, nameplates, etc.) are under Esc > Enhancements > Warcraft.
Your level, gear, quests and talents are saved with your normal save file.
